product_one_liner.value: Luminance provides AI-powered contract intelligence that helps legal and business teams review, negotiate, manage, and extract actionable insights from contracts.

pricing_page.notes: Public site navigation lists no pricing page; the site directs prospects to request a demo/contact instead.

named_customers.notes: Named on the customer stories page.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn company profile lists Cambridge headquarters.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn and Reuters state Luminance was founded in 2015.

eng_blog.notes: The accessible resource hub primarily contains product, customer, and business-facing material; no qualifying set of at least two engineering-authored technical build posts is evident.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation/footer shows resources, security, and contact but no public documentation, developer portal, or help center link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current public job board lists roles but no job title matching AI, ML, data science, applied/research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision.

model_provider.value: Luminance publicly identifies its own proprietary legal models, including Luna/Crescent and its Legal Pre-trained Transformer; it does not name a third-party provider.
model_provider.notes: Public materials describe proprietary models and a model-opinionated architecture, without disclosing named outside model vendors.

compliance_certs.notes: Luminance publicly claims regular SOC 2 Type II examinations and ISO 27001 certification. GDPR is not included because it is not one of the listed certifications.

last_funding.notes: Series C announced in February 2025 for $75 million.

raised_18mo.notes: Latest located funding round was the February 2025 Series C, outside the 18 months preceding 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current job board did not list a position titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Launch announcements include a November 4, 2026 Lumi evolution within the six-month window and a June 2026 Luna Crescent launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Luminance announced on September 29, 2026 the appointment of Don Riddick as Chief Legal Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Reviewed the accessible job board, customer page, and website navigation; these do not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.
